data.title: Family — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: family
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey… We're here to celebrate!

[Hook]
Family time… Tiempo en familia
Laughter and smiles… Risas y sonrisas
Come on now… Venga, vamos
Celebrate… Celebremos
Blow out the candles tonight.

[Verse]
Gather 'round… Reúnanse
The table's set, food's looking great.
The daughter… La hija
She's dancing with her abuelo.
The father… El padre
He's laughing with his friends.
The mother… La madre
She's taking pictures with her phone.

[Hook]
Family time… Tiempo en familia
Laughter and smiles… Risas y sonrisas
Come on now… Venga, vamos
Celebrate… Celebremos
Blow out the candles tonight.

[Verse]
The birthday boy… El cumpleañero
He's wearing a crown, feeling like a king.
The grandmother… La abuela
She's singing a song, her voice so sweet.
The grandfather… El abuelo
He's telling stories from the past.
We all listen… Todos escuchamos
As the memories last and last.

[Bridge]
Games and gifts… Juegos y regalos
Wrapping paper flying everywhere.
We laugh and play… Reímos y jugamos
